'''Mathin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] in the [[Republic Army]] who served during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was sent by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Elin Garza|Garza]] to the security checkpoint in [[Justicar territory]] near the elevator to [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to help destroy a communications relay used by [[Jek Kardan]] and the [[Havoc Squad]] traitors. While there, he met the [[Meteor (Havoc Squad)|new Havoc Squad]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] and provided him with [[53-R high-yield thermite explosive]] necessary to destroy the relay comm tower.<ref name="Assault on the Works">{{TORcite|type=class|Trooper|Assault on the Works|Coruscant}}</ref>
